description:
LATEST UPDATE: companion 1.0.2 (Oct 23, 2026)
What to do: Windows players - download the new companion (https://github.com/vrq8tk5mbs-bot/tf3-minimap/releases/latest) and replace the old folder. Mac/Linux and the mod itself: nothing to do.
Fix: no more "cannot save [WinError 32]" lines in the companion window on Windows.
Every update and what to do for it: https://github.com/vrq8tk5mbs-bot/tf3-minimap/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
RU: обновление компаньона 1.0.2 - на Windows скачать новый компаньон с GitHub и заменить папку; мод и Mac/Linux - ничего делать не нужно.

---

See your Transport Fever 3 world as a live map in any web browser while you play: on a second monitor, a phone or a tablet. No app to install on the phone - just open a web page.

What you get:
- Live map: terrain, water, roads and tracks, towns with population, industries with the cargo they accept and produce, all stations and lines along their real routes, vehicles moving.
- Tap or click anything for details: line load and active cargo, interval, station catchment, industry production.
- Tap or click a place or a vehicle and the game camera jumps there / follows it.
- Filters by transport type, passengers/cargo, industry types; any map rotation; km or miles; export the network as SVG.
- 13 languages (same as the game).

How it works:
This mod only writes map data to the game's save folder. A small free companion app on the same computer turns it into a web page. Open it in a browser on a second monitor of the same computer, or on any phone or tablet in the same Wi-Fi. Nothing is sent to the internet.

Install:
1. Subscribe to this mod and enable it when you load your save.
2. Download the companion app (Windows .exe, or Mac/Linux script): https://github.com/vrq8tk5mbs-bot/tf3-minimap/releases/latest
3. Start the companion and open the address it shows in a browser: http://localhost:8765 on this computer (e.g. on a second monitor), or the http://192.168... address on a phone or tablet.

PC only (Windows, Mac, Linux / Steam Deck). Does NOT work on consoles - the companion app needs a computer next to the game.
Does not change gameplay (cosmetic script mod).

---

RU: Живая карта вашего мира Transport Fever 3 в обычном браузере - на втором мониторе, телефоне или планшете. Ничего ставить на телефон не нужно, это веб-страница. Рельеф, дороги и пути, города с населением, производства с иконками грузов, все станции и линии по реальным маршрутам, движущийся транспорт. Нажатие - подробности и прыжок камеры игры. Фильтры, поворот карты, км/мили, экспорт схемы в SVG.
Мод пишет данные в папку сохранений игры; бесплатная программа-компаньон на том же компьютере показывает их как веб-страницу: на втором мониторе (http://localhost:8765) или на телефоне/планшете в той же Wi-Fi сети. Только ПК, на консолях не работает.
Компаньон: https://github.com/vrq8tk5mbs-bot/tf3-minimap/releases/latest
